timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Do you know, our Sun's magnetic field flips approximately in every 11 years?
Watch till end to expand your knowledge. It happens at the peak of each solar cycle,
as the Sun's inner magnetic dynamo reorganizes itself. During the flip,
the Sun's polar magnetic field will weaken all the way down to zero, then bounce back with
the opposite polarity. Due to this, the heliosphere current sheet becomes very wavy. As Earth orbits
the Sun, it travels in and out of the current sheet. It can create upticks in the impact of solar
storms here on Earth. Thanks for watching!
